# Vendored AIPE-Registry schema

`capability-manifest.schema.json` is the AIPE-Registry capability manifest
schema v0.1.0, copied unchanged from FulongLi/AIPE-Registry at commit
`f419260bc604e5e79ecde9d998139a39a5e0ebdf` (SHA-256
`6d0818650937010c12f5b33efcb1adf9246118f80d989ee7d1079fa8e6e24c5a`, the same
pin AIPE Magnetics uses). CI validates `aipe.yaml` against it; replace it
only together with a Registry version bump.
